name: web-purge
description: A privacy utility browser extension that removes all browser data associated with configured target websites.

scripts.build:prod: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/tmp && cp manifest.json dist/tmp/ && cp -R _locales dist/tmp/_locales && mkdir -p dist/tmp/src && cp -R src/background dist/tmp/src/background && cp -R src/popup dist/tmp/src/popup && cp -R src/options dist/tmp/src/options && cp -R src/icons dist/tmp/src/icons && ( [ -d assets/store ] && cp -R assets/store dist/tmp/assets/store ) || true && (cp PRIVACY.md LICENSE dist/tmp/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cd dist/tmp && zip -r ../web-purge-prod.zip .) && rm -rf dist/tmp
scripts.prebuild: npm run sync-defaults && npm run sync-version && npm run sync-locales
scripts.predev: npm run sync-defaults && npm run sync-version && npm run sync-locales
scripts.sync-version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const m=require('./manifest.json');if(m.version!==p.version){m.version=p.version;fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json',JSON.stringify(m,null,2));console.log('manifest.json updated to',p.version);}else console.log('manifest.json already up-to-date');"
